extracted.intended_audience: global news audiences, partners, stakeholders, and prospective employees
extracted.subtask_description: An about/mission page describing Al Jazeera Media Network's vision, mission, values and the editorial/ethical standards that guide its journalism and content production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision — Fearless pursuit of truth / voice for the voiceless
rubrics_metrics.description: To be fearless in the pursuit of truth and to be the voice for the voiceless.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the high‑level aspiration: journalism should be courageous and represent those without power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — Informing and empowering with accurate, in-depth, compelling content
rubrics_metrics.description: To inform and empower people with accurate, in-depth and compelling content that upholds the value of truth and elevates the human spirit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should prioritize accuracy, depth, engagement and moral purpose (upholding truth, elevating the human spirit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity and respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity and respect are the pillars of our work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work must be grounded in ethical behavior and respect for subjects, audiences and colleagues.

rubrics_metrics.name: People-centred reporting — We tell their stories
rubrics_metrics.description: We are with the people. We tell their stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalism should place the human being at the centre of the news agenda and prioritize human perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speak truth to power
rubrics_metrics.description: We strive to speak truth to power in our journalism as well as amongst ourselves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting should hold authorities and institutions accountable and maintain internal integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credibility through professionalism, accuracy and objectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Our credibility stems from our commitment to professionalism, accuracy and objectivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Professional standards, factual accuracy and objective presentation are core criteria for trustworthy journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pioneering spirit and striving for excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage a pioneering spirit and strive for excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes innovation, continual improvement and high production/editorial standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance and pluralism — 'The Opinion and the Other Opinion'
rubrics_metrics.description: The Channel’s founding tagline, 'The Opinion and the Other Opinion', encapsulated bringing multiple angles to a story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should present multiple perspectives and avoid single‑sided narratives; impartiality and balance are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartial news, programmes and current affairs
rubrics_metrics.description: The Network presents impartial news, programmes, current affairs, and in-depth investigations that push the boundaries of traditional media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial output should be impartial and include rigorous current affairs and investigative work that go beyond conventional reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth investigations and pushing boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: In-depth investigations that push the boundaries of traditional media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages investigative journalism that is thorough, fearless and innovative in approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation in storytelling and digital products
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuing to pioneer new and emerging storytelling techniques that cater to a new generation, presenting an ever-innovative portfolio of digital products that inform, empower, and educate, whilst maintaining its founding principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt new formats and technologies to reach and educate audiences, while remaining true to core journalistic principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to formal codes and standards (Code of Ethics, Editorial Standards, Code of Conduct)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to Code of Ethics, Editorial Standards and Code of Conduct are presented as governance for the Network's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalistic practice is governed by formal, public codes and editorial standards (see linked documents) which provide detailed rules, processes and expectations.
